run_preprocess_cli: run the fairseq preprocess CLI to build vocabularies and binarize training data for translation
build_dictionary: build a source or target language dictionary from training text files with frequency thresholds
binarize_dataset: binarize text data into indexed dataset format using a vocabulary with multiprocessing support
binarize_alignments: binarize word alignment data into indexed dataset format for training alignment-aware models
generate_alignment_dict: generate a most-frequent alignment dictionary mapping source tokens to target tokens from alignment files
